description: This file defines a custom RichEditBox control for handling mathematical expressions in a calculator application, including math mode management, equation submission, text insertion, and event handling.

classes.name: MathRichEditBox
classes.description: A custom RichEditBox control for editing and submitting mathematical expressions with specialized formatting and event handling.

classes.name: MathRichEditBoxSubmission
classes.description: Represents the result of an equation submission, indicating if the text has changed and the source of submission.

classes.name: MathRichEditBoxFormatRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates a request to format the math text, including original and formatted versions.

methods.name: MathRichEditBox
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the control, sets math mode, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: OnMathTextPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the MathText property, updating the internal math text accordingly.

methods.name: InsertText
methods.description: Inserts specified text at the current cursor position, creating a math zone if necessary.

methods.name: SubmitEquation
methods.description: Submits the current equation, invoking formatting and event callbacks.

methods.name: BackSpace
methods.description: Deletes the character or selection before the cursor.

methods.name: OnKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, suppressing certain key combinations.

methods.name: GetMathTextProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the current math text from the document.

methods.name: SetMathTextProperty
methods.description: Sets the math text in the document.

methods.name: OnLosingFocus
methods.description: Handles focus loss, triggering equation submission.

methods.name: OnKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events, submitting equations on Enter key.
